auto_append_rule: After every confirmed defect, add an entry here naming the exact pattern that produced it (value, field, or construction), with source_defect pointing at the report row. Never add a pattern that has not been confirmed in a real render.

entries.fix: Use the measured reference title treatment: real title text, measured position, measured background colour (hex + source frame + sample coords).
entries.pattern: Centered title on a generic gradient background
entries.source_defect: Ray Fu banned list (study section 2.7): 'centered title on a gradient' is the first banned default; Seg3 tournament winner used unmeasured staging throughout.

entries.fix: Replace the default fade with the reference-measured enter (type, frames, ease) from the teardown shotlist.
entries.pattern: Every element fading in (default fade enter repeated on 2+ elements)
entries.source_defect: Ray Fu banned list (study section 2.7): 'everything fading in'.

entries.fix: Use the measured reference palette hex (source frame + sample coords in the palette entry); a bare hex with no source is a guess.
entries.pattern: Palette value with no measured source (bare hex, no source frame/coords)
entries.source_defect: Seg3 full check: colour spread about half the reference (smoke test Delta E mean 3.94, 44.93% of pixels over 3) and study section 4.1: every hex must carry source frame + coords.

entries.fix: Use the verified asset font (Montserrat Bold / Anton in assets/fonts) with the measured family/weight; record the fallback as a confirmed defect.
entries.pattern: Font fallback to a generic sans-serif (FONT_SWAP_SUSPECT)
entries.source_defect: Checker S3 flag FONT_SWAP_SUSPECT: label 2x crop SSIM under 0.9 signals the renderer substituted a default font.

entries.fix: Re-anchor at keyframes every 5 frames or fewer, or pick a flow interval the reference velocity profile supports; verify with the Unit B picker.
entries.pattern: Flow-guided interpolation interval over 5 frames with no keyframe re-anchor
entries.source_defect: Seg3 light check (Unit T, 2026-11-08): tournament winner's copy trails the reference — damped/smeared motion, render 40 matches ref 0 (SSIM 0.9466) while true ref 40 vs render 40 is 0.5480; mean SSIM 0.7441, PSNR 14.61 dB.

entries.fix: Pick the ease/spring from the reference velocity profile (Unit B picker); never ship a scene where every track shares one default ease.
entries.pattern: Every track using the same default ease (easeInOutCubic on 2+ tracks)
entries.source_defect: Study section 6: easeInOutCubic is the hardcoded default in map camera/routes/bar-race; no picker exists, so the default is silently reused for every move.

entries.fix: Replace the placeholder with the real manifest text, or remove the text element entirely.
entries.pattern: Placeholder text or grey placeholder bars on screen
entries.source_defect: m4lkxx article (study section 2.1): 'The first full render looked finished. It wasn't. The post text was grey placeholder bars. The brief asked for real text.'

entries.fix: Use seeded noise only and a pure seek(t) render; re-render the affected frames and check the encoder.
entries.pattern: Unseeded randomness or timers in render mode (HIDDEN HISTORY / RENDER ARTEFACTS)
entries.source_defect: Study section 3.2: seek(t) must be a pure function of time; Date/Math.random/timers/network are banned by lint-determinism.

entries.fix: Design the opening so frame 0 works as a standalone still; approve the first-frame still before the full render.
entries.source_defect: Study section 5, TASTE class: 'the first frame is black'.

entries.fix: Ship seek(t) source + render script + beat grid alongside every MP4; never deliver the MP4 alone.
entries.pattern: MP4 delivered without its seek(t) source + render script + beat grid
entries.source_defect: Study section 5, THE FILE class: 'the MP4 is not the source'.

entries.fix: Rebuild as real coarse-to-fine dabs (detail present at mid frames, mid lap_var at or over 100.0) instead of a blurred final still played back sharp; do not ship a resolve whose mid frames carry no detail structure. See checker S9 RESOLVE_BY_BLUR.
entries.pattern: Progressive resolve with absent mid-frame detail structure and a sharp end frame (blur-back: mid lap_var under 100.0, hf_ratio under 0.02, end lap_var at or over 100.0; end sharpness judged by end_lap_var, S9 additionally checks end SSIM over 0.95 when one is supplied)
entries.source_defect: Checker S9 RESOLVE_BY_BLUR (units/B, 2026-11-08): synthetic FAKE pair mid median lap_var 9.42 under 100.0, hf_ratio 0.0018 under 0.02, end lap_var 1059.85, end SSIM 0.9987; TRUE mid median lap_var 747.32. End similarity alone cannot separate them. Unit A stage2-lint-gate-g2-2026-11-08-01 rewrote this entry from a digit-count regex to a numeric conjunction (lt/gte on JSON numbers), so an integer mid_lap_var is compared as a number, not as text.

entries.fix: Record camera_ease "none" and do not invoke the picker for a static timelapse; a fitted ease invents motion that is not there. See Ananth study (2026-11-08-ananth7e-2119471963790065987) and checker S9 no_ease_ok.
entries.pattern: Default ease fitted to a static-frame timelapse (measured camera move none, camera_ease "none", median shift ~0) — any of the 17 curved eases in the picker's catalogue (easeIn/Out/InOut x Sine/Quad/Cubic/Quart/Quint, easeOutBack, easeInOutBack); 'hold' and 'linear' are NOT covered
entries.source_defect: Ananth study (2026-11-08): GPT-6.2 Sol paints Sam Altman, 35 s static screen recording, no camera move, no easing; fitting easeOutQuint/easeInOutCubic to it would invent motion. Unit B S9 records camera_ease none, ease_fitted false, picker_invoked false. Unit A stage2-lint-gate-g2-2026-11-08-01 broadened this entry from one named ease (easeInOutCubic) to the 17 curved eases in src/scene/easing.mjs EASE_NAMES; 'hold' (a step, not a fitted curve) and 'linear' (constant velocity, the no-easing baseline) are not covered.
